description: Thermische Energie Drinkwater (TED - potentie) is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by PDOK. The low TED potency shows the potential of extractable heat from drinking water pipes. Water companies provided the data for calculating the TED potency. See also for more information. Data from the National tables of the Aquathermia Viewer. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Thermal Energy Drinking Water (TED - potency)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Thermische Energie Drinkwater, TED-potentie. The listing shows 2024-10-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
